monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The accessibility guide creates a high-intent path into the neutral exact-model gear and ownership-cost worksheet, while the storage guide routes readers to lockbox-fit and inventory tools. No merchant, product, price, coupon, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: The new and expanded pages use image-free editorial tables, checklists, records, and source cards. The technical change alters focus semantics only. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 14–October 11 report showed 1,373 impressions, four clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 33.5. The only supported position 4–20 non-brand content signal—Stem Cell CBG at 18 impressions, one click, and position 6.2—was materially reinforced on October 15, so repeating that cluster today would risk cannibalization. No Data-led item was selected. One-impression queries, HTTP-variant noise, four ashtray impressions, two guide-hub impressions, and the Oklahoma page at position 66.9 were deliberately ignored as too weak, noisy, or outside the target range.

authority.action: Rebuilt the thin storage page into a citation-worthy cross-format package-to-lock reference with a lot-level storage record, format decision table, household access audit, uncertainty response, and primary sources. Added reciprocal links through the packaging, lockbox, inventory, label, and gear-comparison clusters. The responsive-table accessibility gate strengthens the public editorial methodology. No outreach was sent and no marginal opportunity was logged.
